Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

Grants the Rapid Hit trait:
import main from 247725512

Direct Weapon Hits grant a stack of Precision Instrument for 1.25 seconds. Maximum of 6 stacks. Reloading the weapon or missing removes all stacks...usually.
